# On-call scheduling tools: pricing and single sign-on

Sources: the public pricing pages for Clockwren, Wakespan and Vigilark (fetched for this note). All prices are USD, excluding taxes.

## Clockwren (https://clockwren.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Minimum | SSO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | n/a | n/a | No |
| Team | $19/user/mo | $23/user/mo | None listed | No |
| Business | $36/user/mo | $43/user/mo | 10 users | Yes: SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Talk to sales | n/a | Included (contents of "everything in Business") |

- SSO is included in **Business** at $36/user/mo on yearly billing. The page does not list a separate price for SSO.
- Yearly plans are billed up front for the full year.
- Only people who go on call need a paid seat. Stakeholders who only read status updates are free.

## Wakespan (https://wakespan.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Minimum | SSO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $16/user/mo | $20/user/mo (month to month) | None listed | No |
| Professional | $29/user/mo | $35/user/mo (month to month) | None listed | No |
| Enterprise | $47/user/mo (annual only) | Not offered | 25 users | Yes: SAML and OIDC |

- SSO is included in **Enterprise** at $47/user/mo on yearly billing. The page does not list a separate price for SSO.
- Every plan has a 14-day trial with no card needed. Nonprofits get 30% off annual plans.
- Annual plans renew automatically unless cancelled 30 days before renewal.

## Vigilark (https://vigilark.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Minimum | SSO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $11/seat/mo | $14/seat/mo | Any number | No |
| Pro | $24/seat/mo | $30/seat/mo | 8 seats | Not included; available as an add-on |
| Pro + SSO add-on (SAML) | $24 + $4 = $28/seat/mo | $30 + $4 = $34/seat/mo | 8 seats | Yes (SAML only) |

- SSO (SAML) is an add-on to **Pro** at $4/seat/mo, billed the same way as the plan.
- Agents on the support team can see who is on call without a paid seat.
- You can switch between annual and monthly billing at renewal.

## Cost for 40 seats with SSO, one year, yearly billing

Assumes all 40 engineers are paid seats (the worst case for Clockwren, which charges only for people who go on call).

| Vendor | Plan that includes SSO | Rate | Calculation | Annual cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clockwren | Business | $36/user/mo | 40 × $36 × 12 | **$17,280** |
| Wakespan | Enterprise | $47/user/mo | 40 × $47 × 12 | **$22,560** |
| Vigilark | Pro + SSO add-on | $28/seat/mo | 40 × $28 × 12 | **$13,440** |

All three meet their seat minimums at 40 seats (Business: 10, Enterprise: 25, Pro: 8).

## Recommendation

**Vigilark, Pro plan with the SSO add-on, at $13,440 per year** on yearly billing. It is the lowest of the three, about $3,840 less than Clockwren Business and $9,120 less than Wakespan Enterprise.

Points to check before signing:
- Vigilark's SSO is SAML only. Clockwren's Business plan offers SAML plus SCIM provisioning. Wakespan's Enterprise plan offers SAML and OIDC. If you need automated user provisioning or OIDC, Vigilark may not meet that need, and the pages do not say.
- Vigilark's Pro plan is the one with audit trail and priority support. Clockwren Business includes an audit log and role-based access. Wakespan Enterprise includes advanced permissions and a 99.95% uptime commitment. The pages do not give an uptime commitment for Vigilark.
- If fewer than 40 people go on call, Clockwren's cost falls, since only on-call people need paid seats. The comparison above does not account for this.
- Vigilark's SSO add-on price is listed on the pricing page as $4/seat/mo. Confirm with the vendor that it applies at 40 seats.
- Monthly billing for the recommended option would be $34/seat/mo, or $16,320 per year. Monthly rates for Clockwren Business ($43) and Wakespan Enterprise (annual only) are higher or unavailable.

- Vigilark's Pro plan is the one with audit trail and priority support. Clockwren Business includes an audit log and role-based access. Wakespan Enterprise includes advanced permissions and a 99.95% uptime commitment. The pages do not give an uptime commitment for Vigilark.
- If fewer than 40 people go on call, Clockwren's cost falls, since only on-call people need paid seats. The comparison above does not account for this.
- Vigilark's SSO add-on price is listed on the pricing page as $4/seat/mo. Confirm with the vendor that it applies at 40 seats.
- Monthly billing for the recommended option would be $34/seat/mo, or $16,320 per year. Monthly rates for Clockwren Business ($43) and Wakespan Enterprise (annual only) are higher or unavailable.
